items.stem: A simply supported beam carries a central point load. The maximum bending moment occurs:

options.rationale: Correct: for a central point load on a simple beam, the maximum moment is at mid-span.
At simple supports the bending moment is zero.
The moment varies along the span; it is not uniform.
The maximum for this case is at mid-span, not the quarter points.

items.explanation: Correct: for a central point load on a simple beam, the maximum moment is at mid-span.

items.stem: Two cash flows are compared using present worth at an interest rate i. Doubling i will generally:

options.text: Reduce the present worth of future cash flows
options.rationale: Correct: a higher discount rate lowers the present worth of future amounts.

options.text: Increase the present worth of future cash flows
options.rationale: Higher discounting decreases, not increases, present worth.
Present worth is sensitive to the interest rate.
All future cash flows are discounted more heavily.

items.explanation: Correct: a higher discount rate lowers the present worth of future amounts.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about applying Bernoulli's equation to pipe flow are correct?

options.text: It assumes energy is conserved along a streamline
options.rationale: Correct: Bernoulli expresses conservation of energy along a streamline.

options.text: Real pipe flow requires adding head-loss terms
options.rationale: Correct: friction losses must be included for real flow.

options.text: It applies unchanged to highly viscous, turbulent flow with losses
options.rationale: Ideal Bernoulli ignores losses, so it does not apply unchanged.

options.text: It requires the fluid to be compressible
Velocity has no effect on pressure
options.rationale: Bernoulli explicitly links velocity and pressure.

items.explanation: Correct: Bernoulli expresses conservation of energy along a streamline.
